From: TideWave Procurement <procurement@tidewave.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood vendor onboarding — required fields for PO acceptance

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for agreeing to get Redwood set up in our AP system ahead of the Q4 integration test. To complete vendor registration on our side we need the following completed by next Friday (2026-11-27):

- Completed AP_Onboarding_Form (attached) with legal name, registered address, and VAT/TIN
- Banking instructions: IBAN + SWIFT/Sort code or PSP tokenization details if you use a payments provider
- Preferred e-invoice endpoint (we support PEPPOL/UBL 2.1 and custom SFTP POST)
- PO acknowledgement callback URL (optional) — we can send ACKs when POs are issued
- Confirmation whether TideWave should self-bill on our behalf (we have a VAT split workflow for EU reverse-charge cases)

A few clarifying notes: for EU services we often apply reverse-charge VAT to the invoice and create a split remittance. If you opt into self-billing we will generate the invoice on your behalf and provide monthly statements and VAT evidence. Alternatively, you can submit invoices to billing@tidewave.com and we will match against POs.

Attached: AP_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (fillable), onboarding checklist.

Please send completed form and any sample invoice/PO XML so our onboarding team can validate the mapping. If you'd prefer, we can schedule a quick 20-min handoff with treasury and your billing team.

Best,
Helen Shaw
Head of Procurement — TideWave Systems
procurement@tidewave.com

---
Note: This message is the start of the vendor onboarding thread.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: TideWave Procurement <procurement@tidewave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor onboarding — required fields for PO acceptance

Hi Helen,

Thanks — we can get this back to you quickly. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I populate the form:

1) E-invoice format: you mentioned PEPPOL UBL 2.1 vs custom SFTP. For PEPPOL, do you require a specific participant ID/participant scheme? We use PEPPOL for a subset of our EU customers but need the exact receiver ID to register.
2) Self-billing: if TideWave self-bills for services, can you confirm whether you will provide the VAT split details per invoice line (i.e., VAT applied by you) or a single monthly summary? We need the line-level split for our internal revenue recognition if possible.
3) PSP tokenization: we are evaluating tokenized payouts via our PSP (Stripe Treasury / Payout Token). If you accept a PSP token instead of IBAN, what fields do you need for your vendor portal (token identifier, payout currency, remittance contact)?

I attached a small Sample_PO.xml that shows how Redwood includes the model-level PO reference and meta (order_date, account_code). If TideWave can send a sample PO for mapping, we will validate the PO->invoice matching rules on our side.

I'll fill the AP_Onboarding_Form once I confirm the PEPPOL receiver ID and the self-billing cadence. CC'ing Marissa (Finance) to loop in payment ops.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Ops — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Attachment: Sample_PO.xml

From: TideWave Billing <billing@tidewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@tidewave.com, treasury-ops@tidewave.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor onboarding — required fields for PO acceptance

Hi Soojin,

Quick answers below — apologies for the short turnaround:

- PEPPOL: receiver ID = "TIDEWAVE-PEP-00913", scheme = GLN. We support UBL 2.1 via PEPPOL channel.
- Self-billing: we can self-bill and will supply line-level VAT split on every generated invoice XML. We'll include <TaxSubtotal> entries per line.
- PSP tokenization: we accept PSP tokens. Please provide the token ID and remit currency; we'll map token -> payee record and store vault reference. If you prefer IBAN, include IBAN + beneficiary name.

I've uploaded the signed supplier terms and the DocuSign enrollment to complete vendor creation: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/details/0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h

Attached: Signed_Supplier_Terms.pdf

If you can return the completed AP_Onboarding_Form with the PEPPOL receiver ID filled and indicate whether you will accept self-billing, we'll proceed to create the vendor in our AP system this week.

Regards,
Helen Shaw
TideWave Billing Team
billing@tidewave.com
